svg.title: Zero Trust Architecture (ZTA) & NIST SP 800-207 Architecture
svg.desc: Zero Trust Architecture diagram showing NIST SP 800-207 Policy Engine, Policy Administrator, Policy Enforcement Point, and CARTA continuous adaptive evaluation.
svg.text: NIST SP 800-207 core components: Policy Engine, Policy Administrator, Policy Enforcement Point, and CARTA adaptive trust.
• POLICY ENGINE (PE): Evaluates trust score using Threat Intel, Identity (IdP), Device Posture (EDR), & Context
• POLICY ADMINISTRATOR (PA): Issues credential tokens & signals commands to Policy Enforcement Points
• CONTINUOUS ADAPTIVE TRUST (CARTA): Re-evaluates session risk dynamically during active connections
ZERO TRUST DATA PLANE (DATA & WORKLOAD ENFORCEMENT)
• Subject / Device ──( 1. Encrypted TLS Tunnel )──> Policy Enforcement Point (PEP Gateway / Sidecar)
• PEP Gatekeeper ──( 2. Query PDP )──> Control Plane Decision ──( 3. Allow / Deny )──> Target Resource
• Key Principle: Assume Breach — All network locations are untrusted; explicit microsegmentation enforced
ZERO TRUST TENETS: ASSUME BREACH → EXPLICIT VERIFICATION → LEAST PRIVILEGE → CONTINUOUS ADAPTIVE ASSESSMENT
